'''Dal Kir''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] and [[Jedi Consular]]. Only a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] on [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destroyed]], Kir heard tales of their heroics and, upon realizing his connection to [[The Force/Legends|The Force]], developed a paramount desire to become a Jedi himself and restore their legacy to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="FD BETA" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he teamed up with other Force-sensitives, [[Markus Dorivonn]] and [[Kasuni Tamm]], in search of a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]]. He and his companions were pursued by [[Sor Venge]], an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] during their search.<ref name="CRB">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Kir was lanky, black-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], and lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. A dedicated disciple, he possessed great mental discipline, but was vulnerable to becoming obstinate. Kir wore [[Clothing/Legends|heavy robes]] and wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], being trained in [[Form VI/Legends|Niman]], a form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. The Kel Dor sported a decorated [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|breathing apparatus]] and carried two [[stimpack/Legends|stimpacks]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="FD BETA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kir appears in the introductory story and gameplay example for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] book [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
